records.Message: Yo, dude, why’d you tell my sister you’re my girlfriend?
Chill, bro, ain’t she been wanting a sister-in-law forever?
Yeah, but you’re a GUY, man, we’re bros!
Relax, I got this. For the date night, I’m going full glam, wig, makeup, rockin’ Suzanna’s dress, and totally slaying it!
Nah, bro, you can’t do that, stop messin’ around!
Bruh, I’m done!
Yo, you see that Agent going viral? Got a dope startup idea.
Yeah, I saw it. What’s up?

Their antics are kinda wild, no? There’s got to be collateral in their lines of work. So, what if we ditch school, start an insurance gig? Like, “agent accident insurance” for all their damage. Bet we’d make bank!
Uh, you sure nobody’s already selling that?

Nah, fam, I checked, no new insurance companies in Nova City are selling this… Wait, hold up. That person always showing up wrecking stuff all the time. We’d lose everything on claims. Scratch that, forget it.
She replied instantly! She likes me too! LET’S GOOOO!
Congrats, dude! Totally not surprised, you planned the whole thing like a pro.
Heh, telling her it’s “’cause I lost a bet” is kinda genius, I literally can’t take an L!
So… you gonna drop the line?
Yeah, I’m hitting her with, “so, you wanna be my girlfriend?”
Bet! You owe me a big dinner when you two lock it down.
Hold up, she just texted me back… Wait what? She said she replied ’cause she lost a bet too?
Man, life’s got more twists than a soap opera.
Yo, I’m screwed, flunked math. Going home’s gonna suck.
What? You failed? Yeah, you’re done for.
For real, not even tryna go home. Wanna hang out?
But you gotta go back sometime, right? What’s the move then?
I’ll deal later. Maybe if I’m gone a few days, failing math will be no biggie by then.
He said he’s into me, but…
No way, girl, you finally got the win!
Yeah, but turns out he sent it ’cause he lost a bet…
What? That’s so lame!
I didn’t know at first, so I instantly said, “Me too.” What do I do now?
Has he replied? Just say you only said it ’cause you lost a bet too!
Not yet, but you’re right, I’ll just say I lost a bet if it comes up.
Hey, did you get it?
Uh, that limited fridge magnet you wanted? Didn’t get it.
What? How? I thought barely anyone knew about it.
Yeah, not many people, but the stock was super low. Sold out in, like, a second.
Okay, fine, you tried. I’m buying you ramen tomorrow.
Yo, babe, I’m on my way.
For real, you’re late again? You don’t love me anymore or what?
No way, you’re my whole world. Just got caught up with some dumb stuff.
Dumb stuff? I’m your priority, mister! Hurry up or you’re in big trouble.
Almost there, promise!
Oh, you’re so getting it when you show up.
You at the beach yet? How’s the vibe?
So chill, I’m feeling great, totally worth it.
I wanna check it out too.
I got some pics and vids, I’ll send ’em later.
Next time, I’m hitting the beach for sure.
You should’ve come already! Swing by tomorrow.
Yo, you gonna return that game disc I lent you?
Man, I still haven’t beat it…
You said that last month, still not done? Did you lose it or what?
No way I lost it, dude! Next week, I’ll get it back to you.
Yo, you gonna return that game disc I lent you?
Dude, I haven’t finished it yet…
You lost it, didn’t you?
No way I lost it, dude! Next week, I’ll get it back to you.
Let’s grab ramen tonight.
Ramen every day? You not tired of it?
How do you get tired of ramen? You in or not?
Let’s grab ramen tonight.
Ramen every day? You not tired of it?
How do you get tired of ramen? You in or not?
Bro, you’ve dragged me to ramen ten days straight! Find someone else!
Hey, can you cover half the bill from last week’s dinner?
What? Never seen someone as stingy as you! You said it was your treat, now you’re asking for cash?
Look, things got rough at home, I’m too broke to eat.
Never!
Okay, fine…
Yo, you seen that viral Agent on Scope?
Not just seen, I met that Agent in person!
No way you’re capping that much. Met an Agent IRL? Then I’m, like, the head of the whole NCCA!
Believe what you want, fam!
Yo, you seen that viral Agent on Scope?
THE Agent? Duh, of course! Even met IRL!
Quit capping, no way!
I’m sending our photo right now, just wait!
Mom, I’m not coming home for dinner tonight.
You’re not gonna have dinner at home? I already got groceries!
Yeah, a girl asked me out to eat…
Well, that’s cool, go have fun!
Bet.
Babe, wanna grab dinner out tonight?
Uh, can’t, work’s got me staying late.
Late again?
Yeah, yeah, I’m late for a deal.
Out on fieldwork again, huh? You’re hustling hard, love. Take it easy, okay?
Yo, don’t forget the mixer tonight!
Nah, I’m skipping, gotta catch Mimiko’s livestream.
Come on, stop living online. There are some cute girls at this one.
No way, real people can’t top Mimiko. I’m her biggest fanboy.
Dude, you’re hopeless.
Hopeless? What’s wrong with stanning Mimiko?
Dad, can you spot me some cash? I’m not eating at home tonight.
Cash for what? Another skateboard, huh?
No, not a board. I got interviews, need a suit from Glimmergold.
Yeah, right, you expect me to buy that? Get home for dinner!
Why you gotta be like that? Everyone’s got the new gear except me. I’m gonna look lame with my crew.
Quit whining and get back here. You’re out goofing off, not working. We’re the ones embarrassed, look at the neighbor’s kid!
I’m out, later.
Yo, you here yet? You’re moving too slow!
I’m coming, man, almost there!
You always say that! Hurry up, we gotta lock down that court today!
Chill, I got it, I got it!
Yo, can I get your sister’s number now?
Man, nah, let’s not. You’re my bro, but you and my sister? Not gonna work.
What? You said she was into me, was that just a prank?
Duh, what else would it be?
Yo, can I get your sister’s number now?

Bro, it’s been days, and she still hasn’t hit me back…
Ugh, you still on about that girl? It’s been forever, stop bugging her.
But she said last time…
Dude, she reported you for being a creep! Can you chill already?
Nah, her calling the cops means she’s still thinking about me…

Look, don’t get mad, but she’s not feeling you.
Not feeling me, huh? Guess that tracks, I’m kinda a nobody.
It’s not about that, she just thinks your looks aren’t it.
My looks aren’t it? What’s that supposed to mean? Yo, hello?
Dad, you wanted that floor cleaner, but I couldn’t find it. Can you grab it after your card game?
I’m almost home! What now? Your mom’s back tomorrow, and if the floor’s not clean, we’re toast!
You didn’t even send me a pic of it or tell me the brand, how was I supposed to know?
We’re screwed, I don’t remember the brand either… Alright, let’s hit the store, buy every cleaner, and test ’em ’til we find the right smell.
Right, I’m heading over to meet you.
Ma’am, I can’t hold it in anymore, I gotta tell you something serious!
Whoa, kid, our age gap’s way too big, this ain’t happening.
Yeah, age is a thing, but the Chaos Tide tourney doesn’t care how old you are!
Hold up, you’re right! My gamer spirit’s back, let’s team up and dominate the championship!
Let’s sign up right now!
On it!
Babe, wanna grab dinner out tonight?
Uh, can’t, work’s got me staying late.
Late again? Why you sound all out of breath, you running or something?
Yeah, yeah, I’m late for a deal.
Out on fieldwork again, huh? You’re hustling hard, love. Don’t trip, stay safe!
Can you chill with the comments? Gotta go!
Hey, can you spot me half for yesterday’s dinner?
What? You said it was your treat, now you’re asking for money? That was, like, a week ago!
Look, things got rough at home, I’m too broke to eat.
Rough at home? Please, you probably pull that line on everyone.
Nah, it’s not like that…
No way you’re getting cash! Don’t even try me again.
Let’s hit Glimmergold for dinner next week, my treat!
Whoa, what’s the big deal? You sound radiant.
Haha, I’m getting engaged! You coming?
No doubt!
Cool, see you next week!

Yeah, what’s up?
Washed ’em once and they bled color! Messed up all my white clothes! Store won’t even refund me, so lame.

Can I come over for dinner tonight? I know I’ve been over, like, half a month straight, but…

Yo, save your friend’s life here! My mom’s gone wild with those online wellness classes, and just came back from some wellness event today. I got home, she’s boiling seaweed with bean soup and some weird Chaos stuff. I might not survive if I stay.
Hey, Mom, did you take those vitamins I got you? They arrived.
Oh, I saw online some expert said you shouldn’t take too many vitamins…
I told you, don’t trust those Scope wellness gurus, they’re all scams!
Kid, they’ve been doctors for fifty years, they know more than you.
Last time you bought their miracle drug, you landed in the hospital! Can you learn already?
That was my body, not the drug’s fault.
Whatever, next time you’re sick, don’t cry to go to the hospital.
Yo, Dad, what’s up?
Remember I asked the neighbor lady to find you a date? Got a lead, she added you on BBChat, accept her.
What kinda date is the neighbor lady finding me? I told you I’m not into dating or marriage…
You’re not young anymore, time to settle down, we want grandkids.
All this neighbor lady talk, sounds like you just wanna chat her up!
It’s for your own good, watch your tone!
For my good? You just want an excuse to talk to her! Keep pushing, and I’m telling Mom!
Babe, come back, I miss those dreamy eyes of yours.
Hah, got dumped by another girl, huh?
Nah, you got it wrong, they’re just friends, you’re my one and only.
So, you ready to marry me or what?
Marriage? Look, I’ve got some baggage, so it’s not my thing. Let’s keep it chill, open vibes. Better for both of us.
Then get lost, don’t come back.
Hey? Still there? Oh, my tragic love tale! I must weave this pain into art, falling into my muse’s embrace… Oh, my goddess of inspiration, even your departure leaves me enchanted…
Hey, I got this killer script, wanna team up and shoot a movie?
You’re a game writer, now making movies? That’s a whole different game, fam. What’s the movie?
It’s about THE agent! A superhero flick, it’ll surely blow up!
That agent? Come on, you’re not a kid, you think they’re real? Their vids are all blatant CGI. You make this, and their company’s gonna slap you with copyright fees and lawsuits forever!
No way it’s that bad…
Look, if you ever meet that agent for real, ask if they’re cool with it first, alright? Stop dreaming. I’m out.
Boss, can I take tomorrow off?
Why?
My cat’s got depression, gotta take it to the vet.
Why not say your parents are depressed too?
Well, boss, you’re reading my mind. My dad’s been kinda down too, gotta take him to the doctor.
So your whole family’s a mess except you, huh?
Honestly, boss, I’ve been feeling low. Kinda sluggish, maybe I’m getting depressed too…
Ugh, fine, take the day and go get your head checked.
Thanks, boss.
You remember that cute girl with pigtails I saw at Glimmergold the other day?
Yeah, what’s up, saw her again?
Yep, just now, but… looks like she’s got a boyfriend. Saw her arm-in-arm with some dude.

Thing is, I’m kinda even more into her now…
What?
Hahahahaha!
What’s got you so hyped?

Hahahahahahahaha!
Whole company’s passing it around! But dude totally blacked out, and he has no clue!

I’ve figured it out! Papaya’s mirror has magic!
What are you talking about?
Every time I try clothes in the fitting room I look like a goddess… then at home, who is this?
Because the mirror’s tilted with perfect lighting. Even scam artists aren’t this professional.
Please, give me a way to look like a goddess outside the store too.
Then why don’t you just carry the mirror home?
I think I need shoes to match this skirt.
Then let’s check out the shoes, maybe? Papaya’s got good ones too.
Do you think boots or sandals look better?
They both look good, so it depends on your taste.
If you go with boots, they’d match that knit top over there too.
If you like them, just buy both!
Lately I feel like I need sweatpants. What do you think of these?
Looks great, really suits you.
I think so too. Should I just get them?
Sure. But will you actually go to the gym after buying them?
Of course… at least for a photo to post online.
This hoodie looks nice. How about we each get one?
Couple outfit? Dream on!
Teammate outfit! For working out together!
Fine, I’ll allow it.
Then it’s settled. We’re hitting Super Core later!
Got it. This time I won’t bail.
How’s this set? Too formal?
It works, but are you sure you want to look so businesslike? It’s not an interview.
Then how should I style it?
Maybe try a different tie color?
Change the color? Hmm, I’ll think about it.
Last time I wore a suit was graduation. I was sweating buckets.
Mine was at a friend’s wedding. Got drunk and spilled red wine all over.
Hahaha, so this time you’re buying dark colors, right?
Exactly. I’m playing it safe.
These brands are everywhere lately. My feed’s full of ads.
True trendsetters moved on ages ago. Now they’re into vintage.
Vintage? What’s that?
… Well, old pieces so overpriced it stuns you into silence.
Well said!
Black or white? Black goes with everything, but white looks great in photos…
Your closet’s all black, maybe try white this time?
But white gets dirty so easily…
Then just buy black. You always end up picking black anyway.
But white looks so good in photos…
Get both then!
Wow, look at those tires! Check out that suspension! I really want one…
Then buy it! Perfect for weekend fishing trips and camping.
Sigh… But my wife…
Oh, yeah… I get you.
I heard you offer customization if I buy a car here?
Yes sir, from suspension to interiors, we’ve got options across all levels.
Then can you add neon lights all over the interior? Maybe outside too. I want it extra flashy.
Sorry sir, we don’t offer that service right now.
Alright then, I’ll shop around a bit more. Thanks.
Compared to Continental Motors, I still prefer the cars here.
Fair enough. Performance‑wise, Continental Motors is better.
But price‑wise, these aren’t so out of reach…
True, but we still can’t afford them anyway.
I’ll save up soon and buy a Silversword car.
You mean save up for the down payment, right?
Installments still count as buying!
Honestly, I don’t think it’s worth it, man. You don’t have the aura. People will think it’s rented.
Not necessarily. With a car like that, my whole vibe would change.
Feels like every car here could hit the racetrack.
Don’t kid yourself. You don’t have racing skills.
With a good car, I could race too.
Will a good car fix your sense of direction?
I guess not.
These cars look amazing, but wow, they’re expensive…
Yeah, even working a hundred years in Azure wouldn’t cover one.
But hey, they let you test drive… you know what I mean?
No way, it’s too embarrassing. If you want, you go.
Dad, didn’t you say you’d buy me one outright?
Yes, but only if you get a proper job. My secretary just told me the company you claim to work at doesn’t even exist.
I was wrong, Dad! I’ll find a job, really! Buy me the car and I’ll do it, I promise!
No. This time I won’t give in.
Oh my god! This panel! It’s not just hinting, it’s outright showing those two are…!
That distance! Those eyes! Two men turned enemies by misunderstanding and ideals! This chapter blew me away!
You two should be locked in this tiny room forever… heh heh… and never come out again!
No! Please don’t! Oh mighty author, you’re heartless! How could you do this!
This has to be a trick… right? It was warm and sweet just now, and suddenly they’re gone forever!
Why… why would you do this!
It must be a fake death! Yes, that’s it! My ship sells so well! No way they’re getting killed off now!
Please bring them back next chapter! I can’t stand these cruel scenes anymore!
No, I’m going to hype this up on Scope! Let the author hear the readers’ voices! Arise, my beloved!
Check out this heroine! Not bad, right?
Not bad? She’s perfect! Amazing!
See? I’ve got good taste. She’s my waifu!
Nonsense! She’s mine!
This part is just too cool!
Damn, the paneling! The story twist!
So cool! I can’t wait to see it animated!
If they pull this off in animation… I can’t even imagine how awesome it’ll be!
Ridiculous! That reason for turning evil is so weak! They broke up over just that?
Eh, it’s just for hype and clicks. You know, forced conflict, zero buildup…
And that riddle‑girl? She had no presence at all, and now she’s suddenly the key character! That’s textbook plot device character writing!
Feels like every character exists just to serve the drama! Motivation and logic are all over the place!
Forget it. At least the art and paneling are top‑tier. As for the story… just don’t think too hard.
Excuse me… I noticed you’ve been picking out records from Cypher Records, right?
Is there a problem?
What a coincidence, I like them too…
Uh… you’re not trying to chat me up for my BBChat, are you? Sorry… come any closer and I’ll call someone.
This cat’s been lying here the whole time. Don’t the staff care?
Cats slacking off is normal. It’s part of the job.
So its salary is cat food?
Probably bought with our ticket money.
… That’s higher than my hourly wage.
It just flopped down by my feet and rolled over!
Classic trick: next step is “give me a treat or I won’t get up.”
But I don’t have any food!
Then it’ll pretend nothing happened and walk off in a few seconds.
Don’t go! I’ll buy treats right now!
This Ginger Kitty Latte is adorable!
Yeah, looks like a real cat soaking in the cup.
Haha, I almost don’t want to drink it.
Hurry, before the foam collapses.
Alright, I’m digging in!
Why does it close its eyes whenever I shoot from this side?
Maybe it wants you to shoot from the other side. It knows its best angle.
Even cats have their idol pride, huh?
Well, it’s been ruling this cafe for years.
Celebrity cats have it tough too. Come on, look at the camera…
Feels like we’ve been here three hours already.
Really? I feel like we just got here. I’m not done playing.
No, you’ve been petting this one cat for almost an hour.
It showed me its belly! It’s too cute, I had to kiss it.
Cat charm surely is dangerous… let me pet it too.
Oh wow, the way it licks its paw is adorable!
So engrossed. Just like me after finishing a bag of chips.
Wait, feels like it really got hooked on the freeze‑dried snacks, no?
If only we knew which brand of freeze‑dried snacks it eats…
Let’s go ask the staff.
Hey, why are you blushing?
What? I’m not… Must be ketchup reflecting.
Then why did you stammer when the staff said “Enjoy your meal, master”?
Do you ever stop talking? Even eating doesn’t shut you up!
Alright, alright, I’ll stop.
This place is amazing. How’d you find it?
A friend recommended it. Pretty good, huh?
Yeah, really nice. What’s good to eat here?
You came just for food?
What? If you’re not eating, I’ll order for myself.
Give me the Magic Omurice! I want the maid to bless it with delicious magic!
Why is the plain milk so expensive?
Because it’s the maid’s heartfelt gift, with a bow on top.
Most expensive “gift” ever. My poor wallet.
So, coming back next time?
Of course! No question!
Knew it.
Master, your Magic Omurice is here.
Now I’ll cast the magic to make it delicious!
In the name of love, become tasty! Delicious Magic! Smooch!
So cute… Miss Maid, could you cast your love magic on me too?
Wow, thank you, Miss Maid! I’ll finish every bite!
Please enjoy your meal, masters. If you need anything, just call. I’ll appear right away!
Just so you know, I only came because of you. I’m not into places like this.
Yeah right, last night you were staring at the flyer like your eyes were glued.
What are you talking about? Don’t slander me.
Tsk, fine, then we won’t come next time.
Wait! Don’t! The food here’s actually pretty good.
Ha, keep pretending.
There’s a photo wall by the entrance. Why isn’t it full?
Just admit you want a photo. Stop pretending to be thoughtful.
Who said I want a photo! I just think the empty spots look bad.
Waiter! This guy wants a photo but is too shy to say it…
I’ll kill you!
Oh my god, this place is way too cute.
Even the menus are pink.
Just sitting here makes me happy.
Want to try the pudding with a heart on it?
Yes! I feel like I’m about to be moe‑struck into oblivion.
Please smile! I’m taking a picture!
Ohhh… S-so cute!
Countdown, 3, 2, 1… cheese!
Cheese!
Yay! Should I take a few more shots?
Yes! I’ll set it as my phone wallpaper!
Wow, this seat is so close to the piano. Will there be a performance later?
Maybe. Wonder which butler will play.
Why isn’t “request a butler to play piano” on the menu?
Maybe there’s a dedicated pianist who says, “This piano plays only for my destined lady.”
Then his slender fingers fall on the keys…
Stop! You’re drooling on the table!
That new butler’s side view surely makes him look like a certain actor…
Shh! Keep it down! But wow, his eyelashes are so long!
When he comes to pour tea, maybe I can get a photo with him?
You said that last time, but your hands shook and the photo was blurry!
This time I’ll stay steady! Worst case, I’ll use burst mode!
… You’re hopeless.
Welcome home, my lady. You shine as radiantly as ever today.
Would you like something to eat? The usual, perhaps?
Mm, yes, just the usual.
Very well, I’ll prepare it right away.
Because you so rarely return to the manor, I, and the meals prepared just for you, have been waiting a long time.
I don’t come back here often… do you feel lonely?
At times, yes. I wish you’d visit more often… but as long as I can see your smile again, I’m content.
Forest of Seals. What a classic.
Even now it still has a place in the arcade.
Back then I held the high score for a whole month.
Wanna try again?
No, no… I don’t have a reason to chase high scores anymore.
I’m a bit confused… what are these tickets for? Everyone seems to collect so many.
Ah, those are prize tickets! In certain games, you earn tickets based on your score. Collect enough and you can exchange them at the counter for prizes.
Incredible. Everyone looks so intense and focused.
Exactly. Some players save tickets for months to claim limited prizes.
Interesting. So that’s how they keep customers coming back.
The new plushies are so cute! I really want one!
But they’re so hard to grab. I just saw someone try ten times and fail, even with a good position. With that time and money, you could just buy one outright.
You don’t get it! Winning one feels completely different! And limited editions aren’t always sold outside. That’s the fun of it!
Fun? The shop is just exploiting people’s gambling instincts. Better to spend rationally.
Oh, come on… It’s just for fun once in a while. Life needs a little surprise and challenge!
I agree. Once in a while is fine, just don’t get addicted.
Hey, did you throw that last round? Why’s the score gap so huge?
Ha, you just got lucky with an easy song. Now I’ll show you real skill.
See that rhythm? That timing? Can you match it?
Save it. Fancy moves don’t matter, only score matters… Oh, you missed again, did you?
Just a slip! Watch me catch up right now!
Weren’t you bragging just now? Looks like your luck ran out.
I’m not giving up! One more round!
Whoa, this track’s got a great beat! You better keep up.
… Hmm… Surprisingly… We’re in sync.
Oh? Not bad! That was some good teamwork!
Heh… You were barely keeping up with my rhythm.
That’s it! Let’s keep pushing for a high score!
… We actually broke the record… Guess you’re useful once in a while.
Ah! These arrows are spinning too fast! Wait for me!
… Left… Haha, nailed it!
What? That counted as a miss? The hit detection’s broken!
… No, you’re just clumsy. Do try to keep your eyes on the screen next time.
Again! I don’t believe it! This busted machine is targeting me!
… Looks like I’ll be failing right alongside you… Oh well.
Wanna try the racing game too?
I think it’s the most fun one here.
Too bad the machines are under maintenance, we can’t play right now.
Why isn’t that guy here yet? He’s half an hour late!
Maybe he got stuck at one of those new gacha machines on the way.
Ugh… by the time he shows up, the best machines might be taken.
Just wait a bit longer. If he left home, he’ll definitely come here.
Fine. But he’s treating us to dinner as punishment!
Yeah. If he finds out we played without him, he’ll sulk. Let’s give him ten more minutes.
Can’t believe we’re meeting here… I haven’t been to an arcade since graduation.
Haha, remember when we skipped class to play?
Yeah, we even fought over a single coin back then. So… how’ve you been?
Just the usual. Work, overtime, endless grind. I heard you’re doing well? Big company, right?
Looks shiny on the outside, but the pressure’s huge. Sometimes I miss those carefree gaming days… pure and simple.
Yeah, but that’s all in the past. Let’s head out after a bit.
*Sigh*… if I’d known, I wouldn’t have taken that loan…
That’s my treasure… you can’t take it away!
Ugh… Blurgh…
It hurts… Why does it have to be like this?
Darling, don’t leave me… How can I live without you…
Ngh… Cough…
This job means everything to me… Please, don’t fire me!
Give me one more chance… I beg you… I’ll do better this time!
Blurgh… I’m sorry, boss, I didn’t mean it…
Hey, do you come here often?
Wanna play with us?
If you’re up for it, let’s swap contacts?
Hey, you’re hugging me too tight.
Nope, I just like you really, really much.
What if someone sees us?
Relax. No one we know will see.
Well, okay then, let’s stay like this.
Your arm’s so soft, I love it.
If you like it, then keep hugging.
Your face is so cute, so pretty.
You too, so cute, just like cotton candy.
Geez, you’re making me blush.
Then let me pat your head.
Do you think we can keep going on dates like this?
Of course! I want to go out with you every day.
Sir! Sir! Please wake up!
It’s not safe to sleep here, and it disturbs other guests.
Please wake up!
Let me take you somewhere else to rest, okay?
Lying here won’t do. If someone steps on you, it’ll be worse.
I’ll carry you out of here.
Look, the champagne I ordered is here!
Wow, such a grand setup. That’s so you!
It’s nothing! What matters is we enjoy ourselves to the fullest.
Amazing! The staff really went all out!
Here’s your champagne, dear guest! It’s such a great choice!
Because of you, we’re all so happy!
Yeah! Yeah!
Bro, tell me: isn’t this awesome?
Totally awesome!
Dear guest, just forget all your worries!
All you need to do here is enjoy yourself~
You lost! Drink, drink!
I admit defeat, I’ll drink.
A bet’s a bet! Hurry up and drink!
Fine, I’ll drink!
Guess I’ve got no choice this time.
Alright, alright, I’ll drink.
Fill it up! Fill it up!
Alright, alright, I know!
Guess I’ve got no choice too.
Okay, okay, I’ll drink.
How about switching games?
No way! I’ll drink! Next time I will win!
Welcome to Sonic Boom, where it’s a vibe!
Is this your first time here? Tonight, we’ve got the one and only Stella Sparkle performing.
They’re a popular idol group that’s been on the rise lately, and they’re gonna be performing their hit song tonight.
It’s about to start, so hurry inside! Have a good time!
Lost Cat?
Their performances are all scheduled by Sir White. You can go inside and ask him.
You’re always welcome back!
Did Velvetstar really break up?
I heard so. The former vocalist already formed a new band.
A new band? Which one?
Stella Sparkle. The guitarist is actually Velvetstar’s old vocalist.
What? She’s changed so much, I didn’t recognize her.
She seems way more cheerful now, and Stella Sparkle’s songs are great!
True, I’ll keep supporting her.
Where’s the guitarist? We finally got Sonic Boom as a practice venue.
Strange, I just saw her.
Don’t tell me she’s hiding in the backstage wardrobe again…
Finally, you picked up the phone!
Can we adjust the stage lighting again?
Yes, yes, I know we’ve changed it too many times, but it’s really important for us. Please!
Right, after reviewing, we decided to go back to the first version.
Hello? Hello? Are you still there?
… Why hanging up on me?
That bass sounds really good.
Huh? There’s a bass?
First time listening to them, and I’m impressed.
Yeah, the guitar’s great. Really crisp and smooth. Good details too.
The vocalist’s solid. I’m gonna follow them.
When the band switches, have them come on from this side.
The in‑ear monitors seem off. I saw the guitarist adjusting nonstop.
Alright, check it right after they come down.
Also, the bass sounds a bit muddy in this venue. Boost the low‑end clarity.
Ah, Miss Starveil, as beautiful as ever.
I know losing your mother and brother hit you hard. Your mother guided your idol career.
But please, don’t be sad. I’ll stand in for them, always supporting you.
Please keep smiling on stage, Miss Starveil…
So that’s our opponent?
They’re strong, but we won’t back down!
A worthy rival. I’m looking forward to the competition stage.
Yuna sang so well!
Yuna! Yuna! I love you!
You…
You…
You go first.
What do you think of this band?
I think they’re great! I want to follow their account.
So… Do you want to come again next time?
Uh…
It’s fine, I was just asking.
I do want to come… You *are* inviting me, right?
Y‑yeah, I’ll go ask when their next show is!
Hey, wait a sec. Hear me out first.
The bassist’s so cool! The guitarist’s gorgeous! Go, go!
Totally a hidden gem band! I’m recommending them to everyone!
Stella Sparkle forever! Go, Stella Sparkle!
Encore! Encore! One more song! Don’t leave!
Don’t cry, we’ll help you find your cat.
Okay. It’s a calico…
Yellow on the head, tiger stripes on the back, right?
How did you know?
Your cat goes missing every few weeks… We’ve already found it for you several times.
Don’t worry, we’ll bring it back again.
We just cleared out that Chaos spot, and now these things are back again…
I’m exhausted. Why does this keep happening?
It’s normal. They pop up the same way weeds do.
But weeds need seeds to grow!
Uh… Then they spread here on the wind, same as weeds.
Wind comes from air pressure…
It’s just a metaphor! Point is, the Chaos spawns out of nowhere!
But why?
I’m an NCCA officer, not a scientist! Orders come down, you carry them out. Enough questions.
Yes, boss!
Huh… Mentor, since I joined, I’ve never handled a big case.
And that’s a good thing. It means our city’s peaceful.
But I joined NCCA for big cases! I want to be a real detective…
Alright, alright, stop reading so many manga. Remember what most NCCA Officer work is?
House‑to‑house investigation.
Exactly! If you’re bored, go visit all thirty shops that reported theft.
Yes, mentor.
For today’s raid, just stick to the drill. Stay calm!
Yes sir.
Yes sir.
If one day you had to handcuff the person you love most… How would it feel?
Hmm… Sad, heartbroken, reluctant? Why are you… are you writing a script?
Exactly! A script based on my own cases! I’ll call it NCCA Case Files.
Pretty sure there’s already a movie called that.
Then help me think of one?
How about The Narcissist NCCA Officer? Fits you perfectly.
Scams are everywhere lately. Phone scams, health product scams…
Tell me about it. My dad fell for one. Spent tens of thousands on a “magnetic therapy machine”…
They even dare scam a patrol officer’s family? Just in time. Have your dad give us some leads. Why didn’t he report it?
Real victims never believe they’ve been scammed…
Not even when their own son tells them?
Not even when their son’s an NCCA officer.
Guess who I saw at Bassline 808 last week? Lykaia!
The Director goes to Bassline 808? You sure you didn’t mistake someone else?
No way. No uniform, but I recognized her instantly.
So you could “accidentally” bump into her, show off, and get promoted…
Forget it. The Director hates that kind of thing. Work hard and climb properly.
Katsudon… I want katsudon…
Still with the katsudon? What era are you living in?
Katsudon.
Sorry, offering you any “reward” counts as coercion.
Katsudon, katsudon, katsudon…
I told you. Just confess honestly, and maybe you’ll get out soon enough to eat your katsudon.
Stealing books from Punch Comics again… How many times now?
That’s borrowing! Readers don’t steal!
Reader? Look what you took.
Mangas are books too! And I said borrowing…
Sit in a cell a few days, and learn your lesson.
No, please, officer!
Come clean. What were you snatching at Glimmergold again?
Cake. Please, I’ve got a job, a family…
You say that every time. When have you ever stopped?
It was just sitting there. How’s that my fault?
You won’t learn until you’ve done time.
No, please, sir!
How many times this month? Another dine‑and‑dash?
Uh… it was a fight! It was for my bros…
“After eating, argued with companions over who would pay…”
He insisted on paying, I wanted to pay, so…
That’s bros alright… So who paid in the end?
Nobody. We were still arguing when NCCA showed up.
Woohoo! Getting arrested feels amazing!
Quiet! What’s so fun about jail?
No jail, no fame! That’s how you become a star!
Jeez, these ones are really beyond saving…
Why did you snatch someone else’s hotdog?
I… I love Lina with all my heart…
If you truly love her, why take her by force?
If I didn’t save her, she’d be eaten!
Nonsense. A few days in the cell for you!
Huh… I’ll reflect properly inside.
So boring… a whole NCCA and not a single Chaos Tide expert!
You’re at it again. Last time someone saw you playing chess at the model shop, and an eight‑year‑old wiped the floor with you!
Who said that? In the player circle, they call me the “Tiger of NCCA”…
That’s a nickname you gave yourself.
Fine, next break, let’s play.
Quit trying to drag me in. I’m not playing that childish stuff!
That bag‑snatching Masked Malice, did you catch them?
Sort of…
What do you mean “sort of”?
They all look the same! We’ve nabbed ten this week, each claiming they did it…
And the victim?
If NCCA Officers can’t tell them apart, how could the victim?
You went to that mixer? Any luck?
Ugh, don’t remind me. The moment I mention my job, people back off.
They think NCCA work means no family time? Don’t lose hope. There’s plenty of good folks in NCCA too…
You mean I should marry another NCCA officer? You must be joking. We’d never be home…
Alright, alright, let’s move on…
Tell me. How did Harry end up a section chief?
You just need more luck. Besides, it’s Section 9…
Ha, true. But it still counts as a title.
Would you take Section 9 chief yourself?
Forget it. Managing that bunch of freaks? I’d rather quit.
Miss Debbie’s been running to Section 9 a lot lately…
Yeah. Normally you’d avoid your ex, wouldn’t you?
Exactly. Can’t believe Debbie’s into that guy…
Keep it down… We’ve all been young and reckless! And…
I get it, I get it. Let’s talk after work somewhere.
When are you planning to take annual leave? Let’s go travel.
I want to, but if I ask for too long, it might not get approved…
Three years married, and you’re barely home. You promised we’d take a trip every year…
Honey, let’s talk when I get back from work…
Get back? Who knows when that’ll be!
Hello? Hello?
That new kid… What’s her name? Reese? The polite one. Which section is she in? I’ve barely seen her.
Her name’s Richie. Good kid. No idea why they stuck her straight into Section 9…
Wait, isn’t the Investigation Division only six sections? Where’d Section 9 come from?
Harry’s in charge. Section 6 was at the bottom, but Section 9 sank even lower.
Stuck with Harry? That’s tough. Her future’s ruined… Just hope she makes it out alright…
Let’s hope she can put up with Harry’s rotten temper.
Heard the word? There’s a new one on the streets. Said that person can take on ten at once.
Seriously? Which gang’s this person with?
Not clear yet, but a few gangs have already been beaten by that person.
Don’t tell me another gang’s popping up in the city… That’d be trouble.
No crimes so far, but better investigate just in case.
Investigate… What if this person doesn’t even exist? I don’t buy there’s someone that strong.
I’m thinking of filing for divorce…
What? Really? I never heard your husband had issues.
It just feels like… After all these years, we haven’t had much happiness together.
Well, he’s always working overtime. How much time can you really spend together?
True…
Next holiday, go on a date or trip. Rekindle that spark… Maybe you won’t want to leave.
Tonight’s security’s on me. Rest easy.
Good evening! Hope you enjoy your night.
No worries. Let loose and have fun.
If anyone causes trouble, I’ll handle it.
Dear guest, my job is to keep everyone safe.
With me here, just enjoy yourself.
You’re looking sharp tonight. Care for a drink?
Here alone? Let’s share a drink.
Hmm… So, you planning to hang by me for a while?
I think you’d like a drink with me.
Want to sit next to me? Go ahead.
Don’t just stand there. Sit, and have a drink with me.
