Aw, here you go again. The test’s over, what’s there to fear? I did okay this time.
You’re definitely up front again. If I’m dead last, my mom’ll nag me for a whole year.
Just gimme a number first, I’ll figure out if there’s any turning it around.
Ugh… I’m done for. Barely scraped sixty in Language Arts. Now I’m really gonna catch it.
Hey… can you hear me over there…
I hear you. Stop wailing. What’s up, bomb another test?
Yeah… I only got like twenty-something in math… I’m so dead when I get home…
Aw, twenty’s twenty. Last time I got a single digit, and I was still hanging out at the edge of town cracking seeds.
But my mom always says even you, lazing around all day, are better than me… I’m freaking out…
What’s to freak out about? Come to my place next time, I’ll let you copy my mistakes notebook. We’ll flunk together, no laughing at each other.
Hey? Can you hear me?
I’m here. What is it? I’m working right now.
Hey! Listen, that relative by the edge of town is out bragging again, saying her family’s gonna buy a car.
Buy what car? Her house still leaks. Her mouth runs faster than any car, though.
She even says you’re jealous of her, going around telling everyone at the shop. I couldn’t stand listening to it.
Me, jealous of her? Ha. If she’s really got money, she should pay off last year’s tea debt first, then go running her mouth.
Hey? Where are you?
Oh, I’m up on the tea slope. Why’re you so worked up?
Who’d you tell that I’m off to the city to be a streamer? That I’m dropping out of school?
Huh? Wha? No way, I just casually said you’re a good talker and good at hyping up a crowd.
Being a good talker means I gotta stream now? The aunties and uncles with stalls at the crossroads are all asking if I have signed a contract yet.
Aw, I thought you really wanted to go out and make it big. Turns out there’s nothing to it at all?
“I’m actually trying to study my way out of this town! Because of you, my mom was in my ear forever.
Fine, fine, tomorrow I’ll set everyone straight, say I was just talking nonsense. Don’t be mad.
Hey? You inside? I’m back from school!
Yeah, I’m here… not busy today. You sure sound chipper, though.
Hahaha, no class today, so life is good. Can I come over and hang out later?
Don’t bother, I closed up shop and went home. Tea wouldn’t sell this morning, I’m feeling real down.

Huh? It didn’t sell again… then I’ll help you drum up business, get my city classmates to come buy tea! What? Still no luck selling it…? Don’t worry, I’ll hype it up for you. I’m gonna hit up my city classmates to buy your tea!
Silly girl, your studies come first. I’ll manage just fine on my own. These days always pass.
Hey? Can you hear me?
Huh? I hear you! Why’d you call out of nowhere? My hands are still covered in fresh tea leaves.
Hahaha, the city kid asked me if folks in Longqi Village drink that thousand-Yuntong-a-pot tea every day.
Huh? People say that? A grand a pot? The tea I just brewed at home is leftover cold tea from this morning.
Yeah, I told her, you should come see our place, haul a basket up the hill first, then you won’t get weird ideas.
Don’t tease her. But seriously, bring her to the village next holiday, I’ll roast a fresh batch for her. Guarantee she’ll get hooked.
Hey? Why’s it so noisy over there? Whatcha doing?
Oh, I’m at the front door. The neighbors are playing mahjong, slamming the table real loud.
Mahjong again? Day after day, don’t they get sick of it? Is there nothing else fun to do?
Like what? It’s just mahjong, fishing, and watching folks play chess at the edge of town.
Hey, is that old game console still at your place? Last time I played till my hands ached.
Yeah, but I barely play it anymore. If you’re coming over, I’ll charge it up for you first.
Hey there! Are you up at the tea hills? Can you hear me?
I hear you, I hear you. One bar’s enough, go ahead.
My classmate asked what’s fun in our village, and I couldn’t come up with anything on the spot.
Plenty’s fun here! That mahjong table in the village, folks sit from dawn to dusk without ever swapping out.
Huh? I can’t exactly tell ’em to come watch the uncles play mahjong. That’s so boring.
What’s wrong with that? Just say, in the city you pay to play games, here you don’t, you can chase a chicken around for half a day.
Hahaha, alright, I’ll tell ’em to come to Longqi Village to chase chickens and splash in the river.
That’s right, lay it on thick, no harm. Bring ’em over on the holiday, I’ll be their tour guide for free.
Hey… can you hear me over there? I’m feeling kinda anxious.
I hear you, I hear you. What happened, hon?
My classmates say they’re coming to Longqi Village to hang out tomorrow. I… I’m scared it’ll be chaos with so many people, I can’t keep ’em in line.
Oh boy, those city kids are real sharp. I’m scared they’ll fire off all these questions and I won’t have answers.
How ’bout… we just say it’s all tea gardens here, nothing else to see. Don’t let ’em run around, or it’ll be a disaster if they fall in a ditch.
Okay okay, let’s go with that. Keep a close eye on ’em, safety first, forget about all that sightseeing stuff.
Hey… can you hear me clearly over there? My signal’s acting up again over here…
Huh? Yeah I can hear you! Pretty clear. Is your Longqi Village really that remote?
Remote how… it’s just lots of mountains. I’ve barely been past these hills of ours. Watching other folks go traveling makes me feel kinda down…
Huh? You haven’t even been to the next city over? I’ve traveled all over for work trips, but none of it beats coming back to the village to lie around for a couple of days!
Lie around, yeah right… when you come back I’ll show you around for sure, but I figure I won’t make it out of here again this year. Gotta save all the money for the family…
Aw… don’t say that. Next time I get paid, the first thing I’ll do is to hang out with you. Once you’ve got a job and some free time, I’ll take you all over the world, deal?
Hey hey? Can you hear me?
I… I hear you. Don’t shout so loud, I’ve still got guests here.
Hey, so what’d you have for lunch? Don’t tell me it’s plain noodle soup again.
Just… just a bowl of noodles with an egg. Couldn’t even spare extra oil.
Oh man, you’re so pitiful. I just had free-range chicken, real tasty.
Stop, the second I hear “free-range chicken” I start drooling.
Hey? Can you hear me, uncle? It’s a bit noisy here.
I hear you. What’s up, kiddo? Got food on your mind again?
Heh heh, yeah. My mom just roasted some fresh tea, I wanna ask how to make it tasty.
Easy. Rinse the tea leaves, stir-fry ’em with cured pork, toss in some minced garlic, real yummy.
Oh, should I blanch ’em first? I’m scared they’ll be so bitter my teeth go numb.
Just give ’em a quick dunk in boiling water, don’t soak too long, then toss ’em in the pan. Guarantee you’ll want more after one bite.
Hey! Can you all quit jacking up the prices?! This is too much!
Whoa whoa? Huh? Who’s this? So aggressive, wrong number?
Wrong number nothing, I’m talking to you! Those spicy snacks at your shop, why’d the price go up again?!
Oh geez, I thought something happened, gave me a scare. The wholesale price went up, after all.
I don’t care, with my little allowance I really can’t afford ’em anymore.
Okay okay okay, next time I’ll run more discount deals. Stop yelling, I’ve got customers over here.
Hey? Can you hear me? Signal seems kinda bad.
I hear you! I hear you! I’m at the edge of the tea garden! Windy and nice and cool.
Wha? You’re out wandering again? I’m still stuck on homework, my head’s about to burst.
Stop doing it then, you’ll burn out. Just picture my village’s fresh tea, one sip and your head clears right up.
You and your sweet talk. I’m sick of your family’s tea. Hey, that’s it for now, my mom’s calling me to go trim veggies.
Okay okay, go on then. If you get stuck on homework later, come find me, I’ll tutor you for free. Hanging up now.
Hey hey? Are you at the edge of the village?
Whatcha need? I’m hauling a hoe right now!
My chickens ran off to the back hill, what do I do…
Lost your chickens again? Why you such a chicken yourself? Go get ’em!
I’m scared there’re snakes…
What’s there to fear? Snakes are all curled up in their holes! Quit scaring yourself.
Help me out, please? I really don’t dare go in…
Ugh, fine. As soon as I finish what I’m doing, I’ll come find you.
Hey… can you hear me clearly?
I hear you. What’s up? Spit it out if you got something.
Uh… that straw hat of yours… do you still want it?
Huh? What straw hat?
Just… the one by where you dry the tea… I accidentally stepped on it and cracked it a little…
Tsk, you stepped on it, so what? What’s there to worry about?
You… you’re not gonna yell at me, are you?
What’s the big deal? I’ll just weave a new one. Watch where you step, be more careful next time.
Hey, whatcha doing?
Aw, kiddo, why you calling again?
Haha, I just wanted to hear your voice, that’s all.
Look at you, all talk. Did you actually finish your work yet?
Ugh, what work? I’ve basically scrolled holes through my phone.
Are those hands of yours good for anything besides staring at a screen?
Hmph, next time I out-pick you at tea, you won’t dare look down on me.
Sure, you’re the most capable one. Anyway, I gotta get back to work in a bit!
Hey, where’d you run off to, bro?
Yeah, what’s up?
My family’s making me go pick tea, so annoying!
Oh please, you’re complaining about picking a few tiny leaves? The nerve of you!
Look who’s talking! You literally beg me for help every single day just so you can go slack off.
Ha, slack off? You can’t see me, how d’you know I’m not off doing real work?
Please, you’re huffing and puffing after picking for like five minutes. There’s no way you can handle it.
You’ve got a real sharp tongue, kid. Just you wait, I’ll come back and show you how it’s done!
Hey! How’d your grades shoot up so high, kid?
Huh? Who’d you hear that from? I’m still in a daze myself…
Your mom told me! It isn’t ’cause you pulled some funny business again, is it?
No funny business! When the teacher read out my name, even I jumped…
With how you usually act, how am I supposed to believe you?
Ugh, I’m really not lying. Go ask the teacher if you want…
Hey, can you hear me?
Huh? Why’d you call? What’s up?
My kid won a prize at a competition. How’s your girl doing?
What? Really won a prize? My girl didn’t go, just heard there was a competition.
Oh, not going’s fine too. As long as the kid’s happy, that’s what matters.
Yeah, they’re our own kids. No rush, take it slow.
Hey? Got something to tell you.
Yeah, I hear you. What’s up?
Did you see? That family on the west end of the village bought a new three-wheeler!
Ha, saw it. All flashy and gaudy, real eye-catching.
Whaddya think they’re up to? Hauling goods? Or selling some new gadget?
Ugh, who cares. Our lives go on either way, it isn’t gonna mess with our meals. Hanging up now.
Hey, hey, can you hear me?
Haha, yeah! What’s up, bro? You sound kinda scary…
That dog of yours, did it go running wild again last night?
Huh? Wha? No way? What trouble did it cause?
Looks like it dug up all the flowers old Wang’s wife planted…
Oh no, I’ll go apologize tomorrow then. Put in a good word for me too, will you, bro?
Why’s it you again? I’m in a foul mood right now!
Why so cranky? I lost my chickens!
Lost chickens? Ugh, nothing’s going right today! The neighbors are kicking up a fuss too!
Huh? Fighting again? Don’t you go butting heads with ’em!
I can’t help it, I’m so mad!
Hey, let it go. I can go hunt down my chickens slowly, and you can just take a breather and cool off a bit, alright?
Hey, you home?
Yeah, I’m here. What is it?
My veggies have been growing fast lately, with a lot less hassle. All thanks to your help with the pests.
Ha, that’s good. The tea garden’s been quiet lately too, just the kids acting up a bit.
Ugh, kids are a handful, can’t keep ’em in check. How’s your tea this year?
Not bad. Get back to it, I’ll drop by for tea another day.
Hey hey, you listening? Haha, harvested the veggies again today!
I hear you! Eating good again, huh? My food over here tastes awful!
Oh man, pork stir-fried with chili peppers, smells amazing!
Pfft, don’t even! My pot’s all plain boiled veggies, no oil!
Next time you come to the village, I’ll bring you some chili peppers and smoked meat!
Sure, save some for me! When I head back to the village I’ll bring you some city specialties too!
Hey? Who’s this?
Oh, it’s me! What’d you make that pickled veggie out of yesterday? So tasty!
Hey, quit prying. It’s a new recipe I just came up with, it’s a secret!
Huh? You really can’t tell me? I thought you added some kind of secret ingredient or something!
Just some wild greens from the field, nothing special. Don’t go copying it!
Okay okay, next time you make it I’ll just come mooch a meal. No other motive!
Hey, whatcha busy with?
Huh? Who’s this? That you, kid? I’m inside…
Heard about that thing with your new tea, is it true?
Huh? Why’s everyone on about that again… how do you all even know…
Heh heh, word travels fast in the village… Don’t get worked up, folks are just curious…
Ugh, fine… I’ll slip you some to try tomorrow. Just don’t go spreading it around.
Hey, the machine at home stopped running again, how do I fix it?
Heh, that busted machine of yours throws a tantrum every day…
Like yours never acts up? Last time you called me to help, didn’t you?
Ha, mine? One swing of the wrench and it’s good! Not like you, all you can do is count eggs.
Hey, your chickens are the real menace. Yesterday they came pecking at the veggie leaves on my plot again.
Alright, I’ll come by your place later to fix the machine. Remember to have some tea ready!
Hey, bro, did you hear?
Huh? What’s up? Why you sound so down?
That out-of-town boss who came to the village says he wants to buy up our land at a high price. Ugh, it’s eating at me.
What? It’s really happening? I just caught wind of it, didn’t think it was true!
Yeah, we’ve farmed it all these years. Can’t bear to let it go.
Don’t get worked up. Let’s see how it plays out first, the village chief hasn’t weighed in yet.
Hey, bro, whatcha busy with?
Ugh, just sitting at home. What’s up?
I was digging in my field this morning and dug up a string of bones!
What? Bones? Don’t you scare me…
For real, pretty big too. Doesn’t look like cow bones.
Put the stuff away for now, don’t go messing with it. Later we’ll get one of the educated folks in the village to take a look at what it is!
Hey, can you hear me, kid?
Yeah, I hear you clearly. What’s up?
Hey, all good! Been fishing these past few days, was thinking about you.
Sneaking off to the river while I’m away, huh? Catch anything?
Just a few little crucian carp. You’re still the better fisherman.
Heh heh, next time I’m back in the village, I’ll catch a big one and grill it for you.
Hey, bro, you at the tea garden?
Nope, just finished roasting a batch of tea at home. What’s up?
Hey, you been on that new road yet? Real wide and open.
Oh, rode my bike through yesterday. Saves a lot of effort.
Delivering tea’ll be easier from now on, takes a load off us.
You bet. When things slow down, let’s grab a couple of drinks.
Hey? Who’s this? Why you calling out of nowhere?
Heh heh, it’s me! Guess what I caught?
Uh, what is it? A toad or a cicada again?
Neither! It’s all green, with super long legs! It can jump real high!
Oh, it’s a katydid, right? Watch out for its bite!
Haha, it’s fine, it’s fine. I even wanna take it home to scare my brother!
Hey, kiddo, whatcha busy with?
Hey, unc! I’m drawing here!
Drawing what? Chickens again?
Haha, this time it’s the fields. Did your chickens run off again?
Ugh, they hopped the fence again this morning, drives me nuts. Wanna ask if they ran over to your place again.
Nope, nope. I’ll go take a look for you, don’t let it get to you.
Hey? Why you calling out of nowhere? I’ve still got work to do!
Hey… I didn’t come in first in the race this morning, so embarrassing…
Embarrassing how? What’s even worth competing about in running!
Running’s the only thing I’m any good at… losing just eats at me.
Eats at you how? Can running fast put food on the table?
Ugh… never mind. Go work on your things, I’ll stop dwelling on it.
Hey, where are you? What’s the deal with these test scores?
Huh? Mom, why’re you calling… I’m at home.
Don’t change the subject! What’d you get in math? Spit it out!
Huh? Math… forty-eight… Mom, don’t be mad!
Forty-eight! How’d you manage that? Our ox at home is smarter than you!
Mom, next time… I’ll really buckle down and study! Don’t hang up…
Hey? Pick up, quick!
Coming, coming. What’s up, why the rush?
Have any of your sweet potatoes gone missing? A bunch disappeared from my field again last night!
Oh, really? I honestly didn’t notice.
Everyone in the village is talking about it! Somebody is definitely stealing in the dead of night. It’s outrageous!
Oh well, don’t let it get to you. Lots of idle folks in the village with loose lips. A few missing sweet potatoes aren’t a big deal.
You’re so easygoing. I’m absolutely furious!
Hey, take it easy. We’re farmers, you lose some, you plant more. Life goes on.
Hey, can you hear me? Signal seems kinda lousy.
Yeah yeah, I hear you! What’s up?
You know that newcomer by the edge of town?
Huh? The one in black? I watched him moving stuff yesterday.
What’s he actually do? I heard somebody say he’s in the tea business.
Huh? Tea? How come I’ve never seen him go up to the tea hills?
Ugh, everyone in the village is guessing, nobody knows the truth.
Well, let’s just ask next time we run into him. Gotta get back to it.
Hey, you home?
What is it? I’m fuming right now!
Heard there was trouble at your tea field again?
It’s those little brats, trampled my tea leaves. Drives me up the wall!
Well, don’t let it get to you. I’ll go have a word with their moms later, get ’em straightened out.
Ugh, forget it. Just a strong word or two is fine, the kids were only playing and weren’t paying attention.
Hey, ugh, why’ve my chickens stopped laying eggs again lately…
Huh? What’s going on? Weren’t they doing better just recently?
Yeah, they laid some yesterday, but this morning, nothing.
Go check on them, is something messing with the nest again?
Ugh, I already looked, didn’t see a thing. It’s worrying me sick.
Hey, don’t fret. I’ll come help you look tomorrow morning.
Hey? You home? We steamed dumplings at my place today!
Aw… steamed dumplings? I just made tea-leaf porridge over here… nobody’s eating it…
Huh? Tea-leaf porridge? How come nobody’ll try it!
Ugh, the kids say it tastes weird… the grown-ups say it’s too bland… they all ran next door to mooch a meal…
Haha, my dumplings got snatched up the second they left the steamer! Wanna come try some?
Another day maybe… teach me how to make those dumplings too, will you?
Sure, no problem.
Hey, there you are? Ugh, I’m not feeling great today…
Hm? What’s wrong, something happened?
My family is so picky… They’re saying my braised pork with bamboo shoots doesn’t have any flavor.
It’s actually real tasty. I was still craving it from last time. Maybe you’re just too hard on yourself.
Aw, why can’t I get that fresh flavor you make…
Haha, don’t overthink it. Next time I come over, we’ll make it together, it’ll be delicious for sure!
Hey, whatcha doing?
Me? Just finished feeding the chickens, I’m beat…
Your chickens sure can eat, haha!
Don’t even, your chickens steal my corn every day too.
Chickens are smart, and they learned from you how to pick the good stuff.
If your chickens are so smart, how about letting me borrow one for breeding?
No way! But I can spare you some of the eggs they lay.
Ha, alright, that’s enough. It’s getting dark, go rest up.
Hey, why aren’t you out in the field yet?
Ugh, can’t be bothered to move, I’m all worked up.
The whole village knows how lazy you are by now.
Say what you want about me, I just don’t wanna deal with anything.
Ha, then you might as well just move away.
Move where? Nowhere to go.
Then quit complaining to me.
Fine, can’t be bothered to argue with you. Hanging up.
Hey, who’s this?
It’s me. I’m from the family over on the east end of the village.
Oh, it’s you. What made you think of calling?
Your melons are growing so well, but the ones in my garden are looking so sad and wilted.
Haha, did your soil get all compacted again?
Yeah, seems like it. Rock-hard when you step on it. What should I do?
You gotta loosen the soil! Add some organic fertilizer, guaranteed it’ll grow strong.
Okay, I’ll go grab some tomorrow. Thanks a bunch!
Hey, pick up the phone, kid!
Uh, I can hear you… what is it?
Did you forget to shut the chicken coop door this morning?
Huh? I… I remember locking it…
Then why’d all my chickens get out into the field? You tell me!
I… I didn’t see anything… I really didn’t touch it…
If it happens again, I’ll tug your ears off!
Ugh… I won’t do it again, I’ll be sure to remember next time…
Hey, you home?
Mm-hm, I’m here. What’s up? You sound off.
The soil in the field, the more I farm it the harder it gets… it’s making me anxious.
Ugh, our land’s like this every year. Don’t worry too much.
Nothing grows well, even the sweet potatoes are all scrawny.
Why not try mixing in some wood ash? My tea garden used it before, worked okay.
Oh… okay, I’ll get some and give it a try later.
Take it slow, the land knows what it’s doing. Don’t lose heart, the rest of us around here have made it through worse.
Hey? Who’s this, calling me at this hour?
It’s me… um, I… can I talk with you for a bit…
Oh, it’s you! What’s wrong, you sound all listless?
I… I got into a fight with ’em, now nobody’ll talk to me…
Huh? Why? You’re so sweet, how’d you end up in a spat?
They think I’m annoying, say I talk too much… I really didn’t say anything…
Ugh, sweetie, village folks are all like that. It’ll blow over in a couple days, don’t bottle it up.
Yeah… you’re the kindest one. Talking to you makes me feel so much more settled…
Hey, whatcha busy with?
Nothing much, just sitting at the door soaking up some sun.
We bought a new wok at home, how do I deal with it?
An iron wok? Heat it up first, don’t rush into cooking.
Oh, use it right after heating? I’m scared the food’ll stick.
Wipe it with oil after heating, then nothing’ll stick when you cook.
Okay, I’ll try it later. Did your chickens lay any eggs?
Laid a few, saved some for you. Remember to come pick ’em up.
Hey? Your chickens ran into my field again today!
What? No way?
For real! A white one, round as a ball!
Oh, that’s gotta be Chubby! That little guy never settles down.
Last time it even pecked my shoe, real bold.
Ha, pecked your shoe? It usually likes pecking my pants, always gives me a start.
Why’s this chicken such a troublemaker?
Ugh, the lively free-range ones have the best meat, that’s why.
Hey? Uh, who’s this?
Dad… I… ugh, the scores came out…
What? Why’d you call out of nowhere? How’re the scores?
Didn’t do well… so bad… I don’t even dare say…
Aw, you bombed it, so you bombed it. So what? The sky isn’t falling, is it?
I was scared you’d scold me… but hearing you say that, I feel a bit better…
Hey, did you hear?
What is it? Quit keeping me in suspense, spit it out!
That kid from the family on the east end actually got into art school!
Huh? Art school? For real?
For real, I just ran into his dad, grinning ear to ear.
Oh boy, the village’ll be buzzing again, haha!
Hey, you home?
Yeah, I’m here. Oh by the way, did you hear? Those girls by the edge of the village are wearing weird clothes again.
Oh, I’ve seen ’em, like opera-stage costumes. They dance up a storm in ’em too.
I really don’t get it, why dress up all flashy like that.
Ah, young folks, they’ve gotta do things their own way. It’s not our place to say.
True, well, we’re old now anyway. Let ’em do their thing.
Hey hey, can you hear me?
Yeah! I hear you! What’s up?
Did you know? A new one moved in over by the old road!
Oh, I caught a glimpse yesterday! Dressed real respectable!
Who is it really? I’m guessing not a tea grower…
I’m puzzled too, I’ll go ask when I get the chance!
Hey hey, that you? How’s the signal?
Haha, not bad. Just got a new phone, real clear!
Heard somebody filmed you with a pro camera? For real?
Heh heh, it’s true. Some out-of-town guy, a blogger or something, filming me picking tea!
Well well, you’re a celebrity now, putting the village on the map!
Hahaha, come on now. I’ll treat you to some fresh tea another day, no need to be jealous.
Hey, hm, how’s everything on your end today?
Ugh, don’t even! My chickens vanished again, drives me crazy!
Haha, your chickens are real clever, slipped away again, huh?
What’re you laughing at? Your tea made money, my chickens are gone. Nobody’s laughing over here!
Aw, don’t be mad. I’ll bring you some tea later to wash down that anger!
Fine, I’ll take the tea, but quit laughing about my chickens!
Hey? Who’s this?
Dad, it’s me! Guess what made me think to call you?
Don’t tell me you got a craving for cured pork again? You and your cravings.
Hey, I really am craving cured pork! And those wild-greens buns of yours, can’t get ’em in the city.
Haha, wild-greens buns? City folks don’t get the treat, gotta come back to the village for those.
Okay, when I come home, save me some, don’t eat ’em all!
Okay okay, we’ll make extra so you can take some back.
Hey hey, you home?
I’m here. What made you suddenly think to call?
Just finished boiling tea eggs, they smell amazing.
Oh, tea eggs! From your own chickens’ eggs?
Yeah, the ones always running up the hill. Big yolks.
Make a bunch more later, I’ll grab some when I pass by your place, haha!
Hey, ha, it’s you?
Hey, it’s you again, bro!
How’re your hands today, still shaky?
Shaky? Yeah, right, you’re the shaky one. You picked the tea bushes bald!
Pfft, you’re one to talk. The leaves you harvested last year? Folks around here are still joking about that!
If you’re so good, do it yourself! All you do is brag. If you really got the skills, come check out my plot!
Pfft, once I finish my drink, I’ll show you a thing or two!
Sure, don’t talk big. Don’t go making excuses to hide at home and sleep again!
Hey? What’s up, kiddo?
Oh hey, uncle! Your phone actually works? I thought you only knew how to work a plow!
Ha, I can use a plow and a phone, thank you very much. Besides, the tea’s almost all picked anyway.
You’re slow at picking, aren’t you? I was faster than you last time!
Slow? With those tiny hands of yours, you honestly think you can keep up with me?
Hey, don’t underestimate me! I work real fast.
Work fast? Ha, talk to me after you fill a whole basket.
Fine then, let’s settle this with a contest over the holiday! Don’t you chicken out now!
Hey, bro, whatcha busy with?
Tinkering around in the tea garden. What’s up?
I just passed that plot… saw white fur all over the ground. It freaked me out.
White fur? That wild critter again? That thing drives me absolutely crazy!
I’m worried, though. What if it breaks in again tonight?
If it dares come, I’ll whack it with a stick!
Ugh, I’m really out of ideas… you be careful too.
Don’t worry, I’m keeping an eye out. Let’s go check it out together tomorrow!
Hey hey? What’s up, kid?
Hey, did you go and take down that wind chime by the main road?
Huh? What wind chime? I didn’t even go over there today!
Don’t play dumb! I hung that chime, and now it’s gone!
Hey, kid, it really wasn’t me.
Other than you and your nosing around, who else would take it down? It was fine last night!
Probably the wind blew it down, or maybe a cat made off with it?
Ugh, forget it, I’ll go look for it myself later. I’ll hang it higher, let’s see who takes it down then!
Hey, who’s this? Why aren’t you saying anything?
Uh, it’s me, uncle… where are you?
Haha, I’m in the tea garden. What’s up, kid?
I… wanna ask something. How do I hide my phone so my mom won’t find it?
Ha, I know exactly what you’re up to! Hide it under your pillow, nobody checks there.
My mom loves digging through pillows… any other spot?
Try hiding it in the chicken coop, your mom definitely won’t go rummaging there! Haha!
The chicken coop? Uh, it’s kinda dirty, but it might just work. Thanks!
Hello? Hello? Sweetie… Listen, something’s happened at home.
Huh? Dad! What’s wrong? What happened?
Ugh, Goldie ran off and vanished…
Huh? I saw him last night, how’s he gone now?
Nobody knows. The folks over at the tea shed helped look too.
I’ll come back and look some more in a bit! And check on the tea while I’m at it.
Ugh, the tea won’t sell either. It’s weighing on me.
Don’t fret, Dad, take it slow. Goldie’ll come back for sure, and the tea’ll sell for sure too.
Hey, guess what I found in the tea garden?
What? It isn’t a snake, is it? Don’t you scare me…
Hahaha, it’s a cat! A little black kitten, real clever!
A cat? Heard there were noises in the tea garden last night… could it have been him?
Probably. Runs fast, took me ages to catch him.
Oh, would that cat hurt anyone? I’m a little scared…
It’s fine, he’s real well-behaved now. Wanna come see him another day?
Ugh, I’ll pass… I’m way too chicken for this. Stray cats spook me.
Hey, can you hear me?
Hey, why’re you calling out of nowhere? What’s up?
We just hauled a weird fish out of the pond this morning, all grayish with a pointy mouth!
Huh? What’s it look like? It isn’t a loach, is it?
Not a loach! It’s bigger than my palm, with spots all over!
Whoa, that’s rare. Nobody in the village has seen one, huh?
I asked Old Li, he says it’s rare too. Might fetch a big price!
Hahaha, you’re gonna strike it rich! Send me a photo later!
Hey, why’re you so slow picking up?
Mom… I’m at school, didn’t hear it…
How’d you do on the test? And don’t you dare try to brush me off!
Uh… no improvement, same as always…
All you do is coast through every day! You’re gonna be the death of me!
Ugh, Mom, don’t be mad, I’ll make you proud…
Hey, uh, what’s wrong? Why aren’t you talking?
Mom, yeah, it’s me…
Heard you didn’t do well on the test this time? What happened?
Ugh, nothing, just didn’t do well… it’s bugging me.
I get what you’re going through, sweetie. Don’t bottle it all up. Either way, we’re not going to pressure you.
Yeah, got it… thanks, Mom. Hanging up now.
Hey, hey, can you hear me?
Yeah, I hear you. What’s up? Go ahead.
That family by the edge of the village, their kid drove home in a new car!
What? A new car? Must be loaded!
That car looked real fancy. All shiny, real impressive.
Alright, that’s enough. The more I hear the more annoyed I get. Hanging up.
Hey, hey.
I hear you! If you got something, say it quick, I’m super annoyed right now!
Ah, what’s wrong? Heard you had a fight with Xiaofang?
She started it! Talking behind my back every day!
You two have known each other for ages, you can’t just cut her off like that, can you?
Hmph, I don’t wanna deal with her! Anyway, I’m hanging up.
Hey? Ha, you eaten yet?
Not yet, I’m busy. Your chickens lay eggs again?
Yep, three this morning! Heh, the kids are thrilled.
How’re the veggies in your field? Mine are growing slow over here.
Ugh, the seedlings are still tender, it’s up to the weather. Did that stray dog run into your field again?
Hmph, didn’t come today. If it does, I’ll call you.
Hey, can you hear me?
Huh? What’s up?
Did you hear? Somebody in the village fished a big chunk of iron out of the river!
What? For real? I thought somebody hauled up a big fish again!
No fish that big. The iron chunk’s super heavy, folks in the village figure it might be some treasure.
Then I gotta go take a look when I’m back, just to see what all the hype is about!
Hey, kid? Why you calling so late?
Auntie… I’m a bit hungry for something good. It’s just pickled veggies again today…
Ugh, you sick of pickled veggies, kiddo? But there’s nothing new in the village either.
I just… wanna eat something different. Auntie, you got anything good over there?
Got braised pork with dried bamboo shoots, want some? I’ll bring you a bowl later.
Yes, please! Thanks, Auntie… I’ll wait for you at home.
Hey, what is it? Make it quick, I’m busy!
Oh, did you try that new tofu? From the family by the main road!
Eat? Eat what? It’s way too heavy! I couldn’t get a single bite down!
Huh? No way? I just finished some, thought it was real smooth!
Smooth? Nah, it’s flavorless! That’s just city cooking, it doesn’t fly in our village!
Ugh, then make some yourself next time, get everyone together to judge it!
Hey, son, slacking off again? Work that slow?
Ha, no way, I’m worked to the bone…
Worked how? Your city job’s just sitting around all day, isn’t it!
Sitting’s tiring too, and the boss is on my case every day, so annoying…
On your case how? My hands went numb from farm work this morning, wanna come try it for me?
Ugh, then you’ll laugh at my clumsy hands again…
Hey, kiddo, how’s today going?
Ugh, nobody’s paying me any mind… the tea stall’s real quiet.
Haha, you’re so bad with words! Who’d actually buy anything from you?
Quit laughing at me… I really am a poor talker… just stand there like a tree stump.
Next time I’ll give you a tip. Call out like I do, and customers’ll come for sure!
Okay, but really, you seriously gotta teach me a thing or two. I can’t embarrass myself like that again.
Hey, where are you?
I’m inside. What’s up?
Hey, did you hear that noise over by the tea garden last night?
I heard it but I was too scared to go check it… don’t know what critter it was this time.
It scared me so bad I didn’t sleep a wink last night… just afraid that thing’d break into my yard.
Don’t be scared. Tomorrow I’ll round up a few of the guys to see what’s really going on.
Hey? Who’s this? Keep it down a little.
It’s me. I wanna ask you something.
Oh, what is it you wanna ask, kiddo? Out with it.
That old tree in our village, d’you know where it came from?
Mm, that old tree’s been there forever. Only heard it was planted by our ancestors when they founded the village.
Oh, thanks! It’s for my homework. Knew I had to ask you after all!
Hey, bro, you home?
What is it? I’m busy, make it quick.
The new road’s done, our village is so lively now!
Lively? Yeah, right! The chickens ran into my yard making a mess, knocked over everything I had drying out. Drives me nuts!
Oh come on, the chickens aren’t mine, don’t blow up at me!
Alright, alright, I gotta get back to dealing with this. Hanging up.
Hey, kiddo, can you hear me?
Yeah, Auntie, why you calling again?
Ugh, my flowerpot tipped over again, makes me so mad!
The flowerpot? Ah, a bunch of cats had a get-together in the village yesterday, maybe one of ’em knocked it over.
Cats sure are a handful. Just don’t know if my flowers can be saved now.
I’ll come by your place later, Auntie, see if the flowers can still be kept.
Hey, whatcha doing?
I’m here, Auntie. What’s up?
My hen laid an egg the size of a pinky finger today!
Huh? That happened? Never seen that before.
I was stunned. How’s it so tiny, like a marble!
Maybe it’ll hatch a mini chicken. You should keep it for fun!
Fun? What fun? You’re the educated one, look it up for me, what’s actually going on, is it sick?
I’m not a vet, ugh, fine, I’ll look it up.
Hey, you home?
Yeah, ugh… didn’t go out, just hanging around inside.
A family by the main road lost their dog, did you hear?
Huh? Lost again… ugh, why’s there always something happening in our village?
Don’t just mope at home. Go out for a walk, and help everyone look for the dog while you’re at it.
Yeah… alright, I’ll go out for a stroll in a bit.
Hey, can you hear me? I’ve made it to Longqi Village.
I hear you. What can I do for you?
I’m looking for something fun to do. Got any recommendations?
Hmm… around here it’s hiking, catching fish in the river, and drinking tea. What else were you hoping for?
Catching fish? Can you actually catch any? I don’t know how.
Don’t matter if you know how. If you’ve got the nerve, just wade in, nobody’ll stop you. That’s it for now, I’m hanging up.
Hey, are you at the main road yet?
Ah, not yet, stuck in traffic, gonna be a while…
The air here is so fresh! Hey, what do you wanna do first once you get here?
Hmm… pick tea? Or hike? Either works, hahaha, you pick!
Let’s hike. I feel like we’d get a full view of the whole village!
Sounds good, then wait up for me. I’ll get there a bit later!
Hey? Can you hear me okay over there? My signal keeps cutting in and out.
Ha, I hear you. The signal in the village does this now and then, you get used to it.
Man, the roads here are so much narrower. Totally different from the big city…
Yeah, a bit narrow, but you can take it slow. No need to rush.
The air’s so fresh, even the birdsong sounds different.
Right? Take your time wandering, we’ll chat more when we meet up later.
Hey, how’s the trip treating you so far?
Ha, pretty good! Didn’t expect this village to be so quiet.
Yeah, there’s barely anyone around. It’s refreshing.
I just saw some folks picking tea, like a scene out of a movie.
I’m still wandering around. Kinda lost on the roads, but it’s real pleasant.
Wandering’s nice too. Once we meet up, let’s go find something to eat together!
Hey? Hello, the signal was kinda bad here just now…
Yeah, I hear you. Where are you now?
I’m right at the edge of the village, real quiet.
The big city’s a lot noisier, huh? Honestly, I’d kinda love to get away somewhere.
Huh? Are you serious? Isn’t your job super busy?
It is, but every now and then I just wanna stop. The countryside’s pretty tempting.
Hey… hello? Uh, I can’t find that tea shop you mentioned.
What? Can’t you just navigate to it?
The GPS is acting up, the icon keeps jumping around on the map, got me all turned around.
Well, that’s a bit of a hassle.
Ugh… so what do I do? I’ve been looking for ages.
Hey, don’t stress! Go find a young local and ask ’em first.
Hey… can you hear me?
I hear you. What is it? Make it quick, I gotta get back to my run.
In this Longqi Village… besides drinking tea, what else is there to do… It feels kinda boring.
Huh? Don’t you usually love hiking? There are plenty of tea hills, go explore ’em!
Ugh… I wanna try something different… how come there’s no dragon dance or traditional opera…
Those only happen during big festivals. You’re better off checking out the other stuff going on in the village.
Hey… I made it to the place you recommended.
Nice. What’s up?
Uh… what’s fun in the village? Gimme a recommendation.
Hm… fun stuff? Uh… drinking tea? Fishing? That’s about it, I guess…
Fishing… I’ve done way too much of that out at sea. Anything else?
Something else… hmm, maybe go learn to make tea snacks. It’s definitely a lot of fun.
Hi, there! Is this the tea house owner?
Yeah, that’s me. What can I do for you?
I saw an ad on Scope and wanted to come check out the tea garden. What’s there to do?
Tea’s just picking, drying, and drinking. Nothing much to it.
So, could you let me try it hands-on?
If you wanna try it, just come on over.
Hey, I’m in the village now, and the signal seems fine.
Hey, I hear you. You went over all by yourself? Aren’t you scared of getting lost?
Hahaha, I’m fine. I’ve seen so much, and everything is so new and exciting! Been taking photos nonstop.
Snap away, go for it. Nothing’s rare or fancy around here, so knock yourself out if you see something you like.
Great, thank you! If I really do get lost, you’ll come find me, right?
Yeah, don’t worry. If you really get lost, just call me. I’ll send my family to come get you.
Hey, I… um, I can’t seem to find that snack stall you mentioned.
Ha, can’t find it? Figures, the snack stalls all look the same. Hard to tell apart.
Yeah… they all look identical, haha. Did you take a photo?
Nope. Who spends their time taking photos of the stalls outside their house every day?
So what should I do next?
Head toward the big tree in the village, and when you smell something tasty, go try it!
Hey… uh, I… think I got separated from you guys…
How’d you get lost again? We agreed you’d stick with the group, ugh…
…uh, I got too into browsing the stalls, and nobody reminded me…
Then just stay put where you are! I’ll see who I can send to come get you.
Yeah… um, just please don’t take too long.
Okay okay, wait right there, we’ll meet up soon, don’t worry.
Hey, is this the guesthouse owner?
Yeah, that’s me. What can I do for you?
I wanna ask, what else is there to do in the village? Something fun?
Fun? Hmm… picking tea, I’d say. Lots of folks who come wanna pick it.
Picking tea? Uh, is there hiking involved? Are the paths rough?
No climbing, just gentle slopes. Just come on over, don’t worry.
Hey? Why’s the signal here so terrible?
Hey… did you make it to Longqi Village?
Made it… so what’s there actually to do in this village? Don’t you trick me into doing farm work.
Lemme think… there’s mountain biking, I think… guesthouses…
Guesthouses? Just for staying? No bars? No clubs? No theaters?
Nope, the village does things differently… how ’bout… you go watch the sea of clouds tomorrow morning? It’s gorgeous.
Hey, can you hear me? Sound okay?
Yeah, real clear. No noise here, it’s nice.
It’s so peaceful here! The folks here just take their time walking around.
Same over here. Nobody’s in a rush, like there’s no time pressure at all.
You rarely get this kind of pace in the city, where everything’s a race against the clock.
Yeah, I love it here. I’ll send you the photos I took in a bit.
Hey, can you hear me clearly over there?
I’m listening! How’re you liking Longqi Village?
Real good. Had a tea cake yesterday, and it tasted amazing!
Ugh, I’m so jealous. I’m stuck here working overtime.
The air here’s so crisp and pleasant. You really should’ve come with me!
Ugh, one of these days I gotta take time off and visit. Hanging up now, I’m swamped!
Hey? Can you hear me?
Yeah, I hear you! I’m at the beach, might be a bit noisy.
How come there’s not a single taxi here? Takes me forever to get anywhere.
Ha, taxis? In the village everyone rides bikes or e-bikes, ’cause there’re so many narrow lanes.
I’m still more used to public transit and hailing cabs.
No worries, renting an e-bike’s no trouble! Rent one and hit the road, and it’s real convenient!
Hey, are you still in the village?
Yeah, I’m over at the guesthouse. Still packing up.
I ran into a puppy today, and it followed me for a good while. It was real friendly.
Haha, yeah, the animals in the village aren’t scared of people at all.
Yeah, the animals here are real friendly with folks.
Yep. Alright, I’ll get back to packing, heading home tomorrow.
Hey… whatcha doing?
Huh? Bro, why you sound so down? Something happen?
Ugh, the project got axed… I’m out of a job now…
Huh? That bad? Didn’t you say your company was a big deal?
No matter how big the company is, I’m just an employee… I’m off to the village to clear my head.
It’ll get better, bro… I’m still at home catching up on homework, gotta go for now.
Hey, did you get it done or not?
Huh? Rushing me again? I just got started over here.
I already promised the boss! You’re making this real hard for me.
Ugh, don’t just go on about how hard it is for you, I’m scrambling to meet a deadline too.
Didn’t you say the design’d be ready yesterday? When can I actually get it?
Look, rushing me won’t help. I’ll do my best, I’ll call you back later.
Hey, can you hear me?
Yeah, I can. Didn’t you go to that Longqi Village?
Yeah, they’ve got tea-picking and tea-roasting experiences here. Figured you’d be into it.
Ugh… I can’t get up the energy for anything lately. Stopped running too.
Huh? Didn’t you used to drag me out to exercise every day? What’s wrong?
Just… suddenly… lost the motivation, I guess. Have fun, and send me lots of photos. Hanging up now.
Hello? You there? I’m in the village, it’s gorgeous!
I haven’t returned yet. The scenery there decent?
It’s awesome! Every random shot could be a wallpaper. I envy you, getting to come back to such a nice place often!
Heh heh. Honestly, stay in the city long enough and you basically start living on coffee.
I’d love to picnic in the fields and shoot some epic photos. Next time you’re back in the village, show me around?
No problem, I’ll show you around next time. Nobody knows the village lanes better than me!
Hey!
Hey, what made you call out of nowhere?
I made it to the village. The mosquitoes here are huge, like little airplanes. That’s so wild!
For real? You can’t be that serious?
It’s true! I even snapped a pic. I’ll send it to you later.
Sure, send it over. Hahaha!
Hey, can you hear me?
Yeah, I hear you! Sound’s real clear!
I ran into a super chonky orange cat today!
My black cat too! Fat and sleeps like crazy, and just lazes around all day.
Hahaha, all cats are like that, right? But that orange cat? Next-level lazy!
Mm-hm, come see my cat next time! That’s it for now, bye!
Hey, you hear me?
Yeah, make it quick. I’m busy.
Want me to grab you some local specialties?
Whatever you buy is fine, I’m easy.
Okay, then I’ll grab extra of anything interesting I spot.
Yeah, yeah, I’ve got other stuff to take care of. Talk later.
Ha, I just climbed a little hill! The view’s pretty nice!
Huh… did you go off to the middle of nowhere again?
It’s all good, I’m just out in the tea fields. Don’t worry, it’s perfectly safe!
I’d rather just lie around the hotel… my heart races in places with no people.
When you come, I’ll take you for tea! The tea here is seriously delicious! I bought a bunch to bring back.
Yeah… next time. I’ll keep resting. Talk later.
Hey? Hello, can you hear me clearly over there?
Yeah, real clear. Saw the photos you sent. You went to Longqi Village?
Yeah, I went there to take some photos. I’ve been out of content to post lately…
Ugh, same with my shop. Business has been pretty slow lately.
Hey, the vintage stuff you sell is actually real cool. Have you thought of any new ideas?
Thinking of hosting a meet-up. Just take it slow. You too, don’t get too anxious.
Hey! Can you hear me?
Huh? I hear you! Weren’t you traveling out in the rural areas?
Yeah. Been hiking these past few days, and now I’m totally beat! Whatcha up to?
Me? Holed up at home, editing videos… still in my vintage dress.
Wow! Your style is so cool! Nobody at my company would dare dress like that.
Well, our company vibes are pretty different! Come visit next time, I’ll put together a whole look for you too!
Sure, sure, I’ve been wanting to try that for ages.
It’s a deal. That’s it for now. I have to go back to editing.
Hey, are you in the village?
Ah, yeah, I’m there. What’s up?
What’s fun to do there?
Hmm, fun stuff? How’s fishing sound?
Fishing? I’m all thumbs, can I even do it?
Don’t worry. I’ve got a rod all ready for you, and I’ll teach you for sure.
Hm, should I bring some snacks too?
Bring ’em, the more the better! Looking forward to you coming!
Hey, can you hear me?
Whoa, what made you call? I thought you’d gone up the mountains with no signal for days.
Hahaha, the village is actually pretty modern, so the signal’s okay.
For real? I figured you’d be completely off the grid, but my line is the one cutting out!
You’re playing games again, aren’t you? I shot a bunch of old houses over here. Real atmospheric, too.
Old houses? They won’t spawn something wild, will they?
Heh, nah, nothing like that, but there’s a cat, super fat.
I’m pretty fond of cats and dogs. Alright, I’ll go check it out next time too.
Hey, I remember your hometown’s in Longqi Village, right? Haven’t been in ages, it’s just like it always was!
Yeah, that’s right. Though I haven’t been back to the village in a long time either.
Huh? What do you all do day to day? Farm work seems exhausting.
Ugh, farm work’s pretty tiring. Got the family fields to fret over again lately, and my folks are run ragged.
Huh? The city’s still more convenient. You can buy everything ready-made.
Yeah. Anyway, have fun. I gotta get back to it.
Hey, can you hear me?
Ha, yeah, yeah. Just finished a bike ride, catching my breath.
You said you took a fall last time. How’s the back of your knee? Still hurt?
It’s fine. I already treated it. Hey, what’s good to eat over your way?
Been eating at a little place these past few days. Their tofu hotpot is amazing! Oh, by the way, did you catch the latest blockbuster?
Ha, not yet. Let’s watch it together sometime. Talk more when we meet up next!
Hey, you hear me?
Uh, I hear you… how’s that village you went to? Is it totally deserted?
Not deserted, just real quiet. But there aren’t many shops, hard to even buy a souvenir…
I just scored a limited-edition collab sneaker today, so stoked!
So jealous… all the village has is tea, local goods, and snacks, with no trendy stuff to buy.
Tea? Pfft… let’s go shopping together once you’re back.
Hey, can you talk right now?
Yeah, I can. Ugh, I’m in a bit of a mood.
Huh? What’s wrong? You didn’t get burned again, did you?
Aw, bought a bag yesterday, and now I find out the quality’s total garbage.
For real? Didn’t you spend forever picking it out?
After all that filtering and picking, and I still got ripped off. Now I gotta go argue with customer service for a refund.
Hey, your hometown’s Longqi Village, right?
Yeah, it is. What’s up?
I made it to the village. Wanna try something fun, got any recommendations?
Ugh, I haven’t been back to the village in ages. I’m away working at a construction site.
Huh? That’s a shame. I thought I could get you to show me around.
Bad timing, then. I’ll come visit you down the line, and we’ll have some tea and catch up on old times.
Sounds good. We’ll have to set a time in advance, though.
It’s a deal. I gotta get back to work. You go enjoy your days in the village.
Hey, you busy?
Just wrapped up a bit, taking a break. What’s up?
I’m over in the village out here, and it’s real quiet.
The village? That’s nice. It’s nonstop machine noise over here, and my ears are aching.
When’s that factory of yours gonna ease up for a bit? Quit working overtime all the time!
Ugh… well, let’s leave it there for now.
Hey, where are you? I just got to the village out here!
Huh? Where’d you run off to? You didn’t go to work today?
Heh, came over to Longqi Village. You even get to see chickens running all over the place. It’s great!
That wild? All I see running around is the delivery guys and couriers downstairs.
The air here is downright sweet. I took a few shots too. I’ll send ’em to you later!
Sure. Just remember to snap lots of fun stuff, not just scenery!
Hey, you listening? Sound okay?
Yeah, I hear you. What’s it like over there?
I saw someone catching fish in the river with their bare hands today! So impressive!
Catching fish? You can grab ’em even though they’re all slippery?
Hey, how come you sound kinda listless?
Ugh, I’ve been having insomnia lately. Can’t get interested in anything. Go have fun, don’t mind me.
Hey, can I ask you something?
Yeah, I’m here. What is it?
Those snacks in your village, can you buy ’em online?
Huh? What snacks? Tea’s available for sure, but the snacks I really don’t know about.
Oh? Is that so. Well, see if you can ask around for me later then. The kind you can stick in the fridge.
Okay, send me the names of the snacks. I’ll have the vendor ship ’em to your place after they close up.
Hey, can you hear me?
Yeah, I can. What’s going on over there?
I’m wandering the village, and saw some old-fashioned handmade tea snacks. It’s pretty interesting.
Oh, I just bought a new pair of hiking boots at the mall. Are those tea snacks pricey?
Total steal. Way cheaper than in the city. What brand are those shoes?
A niche brand, really lightweight. Let’s break in our new gear together when you get back.
Hey, can you hear me? I’m bored out of my mind!
Huh? What’s wrong? Run into something lousy in the village?
There’s nothing in the village! Can’t even find a karaoke joint!
Huh? I thought you said the scenery out there was great? I just finished a bike ride, and it felt amazing.
Scenery’s scenery, but it’s no fun! You got anything going on over there?
I’m about to hit up friends to go dancing, with a big lively crowd! Looks like the village probably isn’t for you.
Hey, can you hear me?
Hey, mom! Yeah, the sound’s real clear!
Such a shame you didn’t come with us. There’re tons of photogenic spots here.
Well, I just got back from a comic con these past couple days and I’m totally wiped. So, I still haven’t recovered.
What character did you cosplay this time? Look how worn out you are.
This time I did a catgirl character, with the supersoft ears! Everyone said it was adorable.
Of course my beautiful daughter would be a crowd favorite. Show me the photos later, will you?
No problem, mom! Get ready for maximum cuteness!
Hey, whatcha doing?
Hm, just hanging around at home with nothing to do.

records.__RAW__Message: 啊？这么夸张？仓库全是他自己的东西？这也敢瞎编啊！

records.__RAW__Message: 喂，我今天真是气炸了。

records.__RAW__Message: 怎么了？谁又惹你了？

records.__RAW__Message: 啊？我只在电梯里听到有人提了一句，说你最近风评不好……我不敢多听。

records.__RAW__Message: 你先别这么激动，旁边人很多……总之先别急着回怼，改天找负责人当面说清楚？

records.__RAW__Message: 我肯定要说清楚的，我名声不能让他们随便搞臭了，待会我先跟家里商量下怎么办。

records.__RAW__Message: 难怪我早上收到邮件，说潮流展暂停，说什么策略调整，我这边预算全被砍了。

records.__RAW__Message: 这次月考……我数学又没过线……老师说想当面跟你聊聊……
